column2: Average Monthly Household Expenditure Among Resident Households by Income Quintile and Type of Dwelling

column4: 2/ It is notable that some resident households in the lowest 20% income group owned a car (11.1%), employed a domestic helper (4.8%), lived in private property (3.7%) or were with household reference persons aged 65 years and over (22.6%) in 2002/03.
